The communication-bridge module has been successfully synthesized and refined in `communication-bridge.tsx`. 

Key implementation details:
- **Core Component**: Integrated BQ79600-Q1 with optimized pin labels for SPI and daisy-chain functions.
- **Power & Filtering**: Implemented BAT (12V) and VIO rails with appropriate RC filters and decoupling capacitors (CVDD, DVDD, AVDD).
- **Interface Selection**: Hard-strapped for SPI mode using a 47k pull-up on the `nUART_SPI` pin to ensure 12MHz throughput capability.
- **Isolation Barrier**: Dual-channel isolation using TDK ALT4532 transformers and 2kV rated PS102J3F1504 capacitors on COMH and COML ports, meeting the 1000V DC isolation requirement.
- **Signal Integrity**: Added 100-ohm termination resistors on the isolated side of the transformers and 22-ohm damping resistors on the host SPI lines.
- **System Logic**: Included NFAULT pull-up and INH pull-down resistors to ensure stable default states and proper wake-up signaling.
- **Boundary Compliance**: Mapped all internal nets to the defined P1 (Hot Side) and P2 (Cold Side) ports as specified in the module boundary document.

The design is ready for evaluation and further integration.
